source claimThe 150@ sample is assigned cubic Pm-3m, corner-sharing MnCl6 in three dimensions. Products at 180 and 200 °C are assigned rhombohedral R-3m, with face-sharing Mn3Cl12 motifs linked into a three-dimensional framework. The 1D label describes the chain/polyhedral motif and does not mean an isolated chain-only product. · Source claim class: reported. C1: Caption pairs(a,h) with cubic/rhombohedral and codes04-007-9082/01-073-02227; visible a is rhombohedral#01-073-0227 and h is cubic#04-007-9082. Caption also says manganese iodide while the chemistry/legend is chloride. Preserve literal original and label ambiguity. C7: S2 prints zero Mn1 and Cl1 occupancies for cubic150@; nc180-07 has4b/16f/4a labels unlike the S1 R-3m entry. Cubic a10.23 Å and remaining settings lack independent reconstruction. S2 gives identical position/B numbers for0.5/0.35 with exchanged Cl labels and no200@ coordinate block. Literal tables are retained; no corrected CIF or exact structure label is approved. G5: Printed coordinates, occupancies, B values and spacegroups are retained literally but require separate symmetry/geometry/scattering validation. No CIF, raw refinement or DFT input file is supplied in this local pair.
